bullets.body: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) Wednesday arxiv landings extend the signed-checkpoint plus sovereign-cloud composition verification waves and add a workflow-state path-canonicalization formal-verification anchor. Verifiable Workflow-State Path Canonicalization for Agentic AI Multi-Tier Loaders (arxiv 2605.06799) ships Wednesday as a fresh paper extending the runtime-verifier preprint shipped Monday plus the Tuesday inference-routing addendum to cover the workflow-state path tier exposed by the Wednesday AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 disclosure; the paper provides formal compositional safety theorems for the three-tier load-runtime-workflow loader pattern plus reference implementations in Python and Rust, with MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, Anthropic, Microsoft, EU AI Office, plus the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat continuing as authors and Stanford CIS plus the Brennan Center adding as institutional reviewers. Stable Long-Context Reinforcement Learning via Router-Aware Advantage Decomposition (arxiv 2605.05844 v6) adds a Wednesday extension showing the technique closes the long-context training-stability gap on the new quad-Hopper kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention forward-and-backward pass setup from the Unsloth Wednesday changelog, with pre-tested integration against vLLM v0.11.3, SGLang RadixArk v0.5.7, and TGI v3.2.0 signed-checkpoint loaders simultaneously — the first three-stack training-and-serving end-to-end formal-verification chain at the local-LLM workstation tier.

bullets.body: (Del resumen en inglés de hoy) DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-publish a Wednesday joint follow-up addendum v2 on agentic-AI runtime-verifier integration extending to the workflow-state tier. Runtime Signature-Verification and Manifest-Allowlist Enforcement for Agentic AI Inference Pipelines v2 (arxiv 2605.06712v2) extends the Tuesday runtime-verifier paper with a workflow-state path-canonicalization integration pattern compatible across the LangChain LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Haystack, LiteLLM, Pydantic AI, and now AutoGen workflow-state path cohort; the paper provides reference implementations in Python and Rust for the workflow-state mitigation plus formal compositional safety proofs covering all nine CVE-pattern instances. Microsoft, LangChain, the CrewAI maintainer team, the Pydantic AI maintainer team, plus the AutoGen maintainer team publish parallel Wednesday commitments to ship the three-tier mitigation integration as a default in the next minor-version release of each respective framework, with the coordinated mid-June default-shipment target window now extended to cover load-time signed-checkpoint plus runtime manifest-allowlist-validation plus workflow-state path-canonicalization as a paired three-tier delivery.
